text:
Maya: FYI SummitTrust wants a week-long POC next week. Their checklist: enterprise SSO (SAML) with signed assertions, SCIM for ~1M accounts (initial bulk + daily deltas), strict RBAC mappings per OU, and domain-locked tenants (no self-serve). They also want visibility on pricing differences between spinning a short Dedicated slice vs using Private, and longer audit retention options. @Arjun can you confirm SCIM seed strategy and throughput expectations?

Arjun: Yep. Recommendation: use our bulk import for the initial 1M seed (single compressed payload), then PATCH-based deltas for daily changes. Hosted SCIM default rate handles ~400-600 req/s; for large customers we enable a higher rate-limit and provide a recommended parallel worker pattern with backoff. Example customer delta PATCH we provide:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    { "op": "replace", "path": "members", "value": [{ "value": "user-9876", "displayName": "Jane Doe" }] }
  ]
}
```
We have validated flows with Okta and Azure AD; OneLogin is supported but we advise a short smoke test. Groups -> role mapping is supported; we'll share a mapping template.

Priya: Security items to call out for RFP: exchange SAML metadata (IdP & SP), signature and audience validation, recommended assertion validity window (5 min), optional SP-initiated/IdP-initiated guidance, and clock skew tolerance. SCIM: scoped token per tenant, token rotation cadence (90 days), optional mTLS for Private, IP allowlist. Audit logs: hosted = 30 days by default; Dedicated can be extended to 90/180 days for an add-on; Private = customer-managed retention and archive to S3. Encryption: AES-256 at rest + KMS; TLS1.2+ in transit.

Leo: Commercials: temporary Dedicated env for a 2-week POC is doable (estimated infra surcharge ~$1,100/day) plus one-time SCIM seed ops ($2k). Private requires a minimum term and ~3 week lead. I'll confirm final numbers with finance and post in this thread.

Maya: Summit asked about domain verification and automatic tenant mapping: can we enforce domain-lock so users from unverified domains cannot create tenants? Also they want domain ownership proofing docs.

Arjun: Yes. We support DNS TXT verification and then enable domain-lock which prevents new tenant creation unless the domain is verified. We can auto-map authenticated sessions to tenants when the email domain is verified. Also support SAML attribute mapping: use eduPersonPrincipalName or custom attribute to map to groups -> RBAC roles. We'll share the attribute mapping sample.

Priya: For the SCIM seed safety: recommend dry-run mode (no-op), a pre-seed snapshot and a plan to run idempotent upserts to avoid accidental deletes. Also enable provisioning audit events export for compliance reviewers.

Maya: I'll produce a short RFP appendix with: seed+delta flow, security controls checklist, RBAC mapping example, and rollback plan. @Leo please drop POC pricing and a timeline by EOD. Need a kickoff with their infra + IdP engineer.

calendar-bot: Created event "SummitTrust POC kickoff" Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 - invites: Maya, Arjun, Priya, Leo, summit-infra.

Maya: One more ask from them: retention for SAML assertions in logs for forensic purposes. Priya, can we surface how long we keep SAML auth events and whether we can export them?

Priya: Hosted logs: auth events retained 30 days; export possible via API to their S3 for longer retention. Dedicated: configurable retention and export as an add-on. Private: full control. I'll include export sample calls in the RFP doc. :white_check_mark:
